explication: Dynamo is a visual programming environment: users assemble node graphs and custom logic, then run them through its DesignScript engine and inspect results in the Windows UI. The repository also provides node-library discovery, package management, documentation, and extension points. The graph emphasizes the model-to-engine execution core and documented user capabilities; several peripheral subsystems are represented at their source directories because their implementations were not sampled, so their connections are left unverified where necessary.
